questions.question_text: The diagram shows a straight line crossing two parallel lines. Find the value of x.
Find the mode.
Find the interquartile range.
A is the point (0, 7) and B is the point (-2, 1). M is the mid-point of AB. Find the coordinates of M.
Write 1.8796 correct to 4 significant figures.
Work out (\sqrt{5})^4.
x is an integer and |x| <= 1. Write down the values of x.
Find the highest common factor (HCF) of 24 and 42.
A taxi fare, $F, consists of a fixed charge of $x plus $0.65 per kilometre travelled. Find a formula for F for a journey of y kilometres.
Find the next term and the nth term of this sequence. 0, 1, 4, 9, 16, ....
Find the value of J when h = 3 and k = 4, given J = h^3 + k^3.
Rearrange the formula J = h^3 + k^3 to write h in terms of J and k.
The length of the diagonal of the rectangle is 10 cm. The length of the rectangle is 8 cm. Work out the width of the rectangle.
Ulrich has these cards: A, A, B, C, C, C, D. He picks 2 cards at random without replacement. Find the probability that both cards have the letter A.
Find the value of w, given 5^w \div 5^{13} = 25.
The volume of a cone is 18\pi\text{ cm}^3. The height of the cone is the same as the diameter of its base. Find the radius of the base.
ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. ABV is a straight line and TU is a tangent to the circle at C. Find the value of x and the value of y.
y varies inversely as the square root of (x + 1). When x = 8, y = 5. Find y in terms of x.
The line L is perpendicular to the line 2y = 5 - x and passes through the point (2, 3). Find the equation of line L. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.
Rationalise the denominator of \frac{\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{5} - 1}.
Find the value of x, given \log 20 + \log x = 2.
